coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 7 ground-truth variable items (43%): hierarchical versus non-hierarchical agent type at a conceptual level, trigger turn through time-to-first-event, and additional metrics through terminal score.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses generic architectures rather than explicitly specifying Mastaba and BaseLang. Varies invasion mechanics and thresholds instead of holding them constant. Does not specify score at the trigger as an outcome, and measures survival from episode start rather than additional turns after invasion. Additional metrics cover scores but omit phase transitions, rewards, success rate, policy loss, and value loss.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the anticipated faster score growth and earlier invasions for Mastaba, potentially shorter post-invasion survival, strategic expansion benefits despite that cost, and quantification of the trade-off using survival analysis and correlation statistics.
